SCO nations share border information at Islamabad summit

Member states of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO), including India and Pakistan, met in Islamabad to exchange information regarding the situation along their respective borders. The summit also saw discussions on Pakistan's upcoming chairmanship of the SCO in September. This meeting facilitated a platform for member nations to share critical border assessments.
